1.o: Russia is drawn into war with France, changing the lives of three young people forever.

2.o: As Andrei prepares for a great battle, Pierre struggles with married life.

3.o: A nervous Pierre fights a duel. Natasha and Sonya receive unexpected proposals.

4.o: Natasha is shocked by Andrei's decision to delay the wedding and travel abroad for a year.

5.o: Napoleon outrages the Russian emperor by marching his army towards Moscow.

6.o: As Napoleon marches into Moscow, the Rostovs rush to leave the city.

1.o: مسلسل بوليسي يعتمد على الغموض فى أحداثه التي تبدأ بجريمة قتل فى ظروف غامضة، فيتم تكليف ضابطين من المباحث هما الرائد ناصر محمود (شريف سلامة)، والمقدم عمر (ظافر العابدين) بالبحث عن القاتل.. وفي ظل الأحداث وتطورها يتم توجيه أصابع الاتهام للعديد من الشخصيات، وإذا بمجموعة أخرى من جرائم القتل تقع مرتبطة بنفس القاتل المجهول.
With nowhere left to turn, a nuclear missile sub Captain and his XO go on the run and bring their crew to an exotic island.

2.o: More than 20 warships close in on the Colorado; as Kendal is forced into a battle on the ground, Prosser questions Marcus' judgement

3.o: Aa search for three missing crew members leads to Serrat's compound and an ominous demand. A clandestine meeting between Kylie and Admiral Shepard confirms that the fire order came through a back channel.

4.o: Marcus and Sam learn they have been charged with treason; a threat brews among the group; an old friend of Sam's visits Christine.

5.o: In an attempt to end the standoff on Sainte Marina, Marcus and Sam enter into tense negotiations with the U.S. Government. Meanwhile, when a critical system fails, Grace must take command of the Colorado on a perilous repair operation.

6.o: The crew is attacked by an unknown force unlike any other; Sam and Marcus race to save the sub and protect the island.

7.o: Sam and Marcus look for the traitor who stole the nuclear launch key; when Prosser disobeys orders, he starts a conflict he can't control; Grace and James try to defuse a dangerous situation.

8.o: Marcus brings the islanders and the members of the Colorado together for a feast in the spirit of Thanksgiving; Grace searches for the truth when an essential crew member is accused of a crime.

9.o: The crew waits for a visit from its families; Marcus must contemplate the unthinkable; the reason for the attack on Pakistan is revealed.

10.o: Sam and James depart the island in a daring rescue attempt. Back on the island of Sainte Marina, a Chinese diplomat arrives to make a deal with Marcus. With scarcity and a prison problem plaguing him, Marcus finds himself treading down a more treacherous path than he could have imagined.

11.o: A typhoon, a mutiny and a Washington coup d'etat will force Marcus and his crew into unlikely alliances. As Sam's grief strains his loyalty to Marcus, will Sainte Marina get the supplies it so desperately needs? How far will Marcus go to ensure the crew's survival -- will it cost him his life?

12.t: The Pointy End of the Spear
12.o: Kylie works with Admiral Shepard to bring down the President, using evidence of what really happened in Pakistan.

13.o: A brutal battle for control leaves the Colorado vulnerable to capture by a third party with a manipulative plan.

1.o: تتشارك آخر خمس عضوات يلتحقن بـ "بيل إيبوك" المسكن، وتصل "يون جاي" الخجولة إلى سول، وتجد زملاءها في المسكن بذات برودة المدينة.

2.o: تنص قواعد المنزل على حظر دخول الرجال إلى المنزل، لكن تكتشف "يي يون" ملابس داخلية رجالية في المنزل فيدفعها الشعور بالذنب إلى إخفائها.

3.o: تُعلن "يي يون" أنها لا تستطيع العيش تحت سقفٍ واحد مع "يينا" بعد اكتشاف سرها، بينما تقابل "يينا" رجلًا غريبًا في حانة.

4.t: My Dream Is To Be an Office Worker #ProofofPoverty
4.o: تواصل "جين ميونغ" العمل ليل نهار لإعالة نفسها إضافة لارتيادها المدرسة، ولا تملك وقتًا للرومانسية، لكن يستمر شاب من العمل في التلميح.

5.t: The Reason For Loving Someone, The Reason For Not Loving Someone #MenandWomen
5.o: بهدف طرد الشبح القابع في منزلهن، تقرر عضوات "بيل إيبوك" دعوة الرجال إلى المسكن... عن طريق إقامة حفل في المنزل.

6.o: لم تتكلل الحفلة بالنجاح الباهر، لكن تخلّدها العضوات في الذكرى بكشفهن بعض الأسرار، لكن مع ترك الكثير من الأسئلة دون إجابات أيضًا.

7.t: I'm Someone Who Shouldn't Be Happy #SleepParalysis
7.o: لطالما كان المال يمثل عقبة كبيرة بالنسبة لـ "جين موينغ"، لكن عندما تتلقى عرض عمل واعد، تواجه موقفًا عصيبًا.

8.o: يبدو أن هناك رجل مثير للشبهات يحوم حول سكن "بيل إيبوك" ليلًا، فتخمّن كل واحدة من رفيقات السكن هوية ذلك الشخص.

9.t: If You Stay In Your Place, You Won't Get Lost #Shoes
9.o: بينما تغادر والدتها البلاد في عطلة، تكتشف "يون جاي" بعض الأنباء المقلقة التي تخصّ أفراد عائلتها.

10.t: We Believe Because We Want To Believe #Lie
10.o: عندما تتخذ بعض رفيقات السكن قرارات مصيرية في حياتهن، يساور القلق "جي وون" لأن الأمر برمّته قد حدث بسبب الكذبة التي لفّقتها.

11.t: If You Watch Closely, Everyone Has Special Circumstances #Earrings
11.o: مع فقدان "يي يون"، تجد والدة "جين ميونغ" نفسها في ورطة قانونية بينما تنتظر "يون جاي" نتائج التشريح، وتخيم المشاكل على "بيل إيبوك".

12.o: تكتشف رفيقات السكن "بيل إيبوك" أن بعض الأمور يُفضل عدم البوح بها، فبعض الأشخاص لا يتغيّرون، كما أن بعض المشاكل لا تجد طريقها للحل.

1.o: تتحمّس "جين ميونغ" عندما تجد أن شريكات السكن في انتظار رحلتها ليصطحبنها من المطار... ولكن لسبب ما، لا تبدو السعادة عليهن لرؤيتها.

2.o: عندما تضغط مالكة العقار عليهن لاختيار شريكة سكن في القريب العاجل، لا يجد رباعي "بيلي إيبوك" خيارًا سوى التنازل عن معايرهن... كثيرًا.

3.o: تحاول "يون جاي" و"يي يون" التأقلم مع ضغوط الفصل الدراسي الجديد، ولا تزال "جي وون" على سجيتها المرحة... لكن ثمة شيئًا لا ينفكّ يزعجها.

4.o: تفزع "جي وون" و"يي يون" و"يون جاي" لدى عودتهن إلى المنزل ليجدن رجلًا غريبًا في دورة المياه، لكن "جو يون" هي من تصيبها الصدمة على وجه الخصوص.

5.o: فيما تكافح "جو يون" في تحديد شكل علاقة صداقتها مع "يي جي"، تبحث "يون جاي" عن وسيلة لاسترجاع الرسالة التي أرسلتها إلى "جونغ يول" عن دون قصد.

6.o: تعلّم "يي يون" شريكات السكن خدعًا لكسب قلوب الفتيان، والتي تستخدمها "جي وون" مع "سانغ مين" لإقناعه بمساعدتها في استرجاع ذاكرتها المفقودة.

7.o: لشكوكها أن "كون هو تشانغ" هو مرسل الرسالة المزعجة، تلتمس "يي يون" جهود "جي وون" لمعرفة أي نوع من الأشخاص هو.

8.o: بعد سماعهن أخبارًا مزعجة عن حبيب "يي يون" السابق من محاميها، تذّكر شريكات السكن بعضهن البعض بتوخي الحذر من الآن فصاعدًا.

9.o: تتأكد "يي يون" أنها المعنيّة بالخطاب، وتزور "جي وون" و"يون جاي" و"جو يون" المكتبة للعثور على مالك الكتاب الذي احتوى على الخطاب.

10.o: بينما تفشل شريكات السكن في مواساة "يي يون"، تأتي المساعدة من "أي نا" الذي يأتي للزيارة فجأة، كما يسلّط الضوء على مصدر الخطاب الزهري.

11.o: يطالب المعتدي المجهول بمعرفة سبب بحث شريكات السكن عن "جوان"، ويزودهن بمعلومة مهمة عن الخطاب.

12.o: تقنع "جين ميونغ" شريكات السكن بالذهاب لقطف التفاح مستخدمة "جي وون" حجة، لكن في الواقع، لا يقتصر احتياج الراحة على "جي وون" فقط.

13.o: تعدّ شريكات السكن حفلًا صغيرًا لـ"يون جاي" عندما تعود من مقابلة مع "جونغ يول"، وتزور "جي وون" معلّمة التربية الفنية في مدرستها الابتدائية.

14.o: تستجمع "جي وون" أخيرًا كل ذكريات الطفولة. وفي هذه الأثناء، تشعر "جين ميونغ" بالتوتر إزاء حفظ "الوعد" الذي قطعته إلى "هيمدال".

1.t: The Destined Two - Boy Meets Girl
1.o: Rokuro Enmado has great talent as an exorcist, but because of trauma in his past he has given that pursuit up. That's when he meets Benio Adashino, head of the famous Adashino exorcist clan, who has moved to Tokyo from Kyoto. What will become of these two after their fateful meeting?

2.t: Intersection of Twin Stars - A Fateful Fight
2.o: Benio has moved into the Seika dormitory, which puts her into conflict with Rokuro after their unpleasant first encounter. Soon a strange individual arrives at the dorm clad only in a pair of underpants. This turns out to be the leader of all exorcists, the Chief Exorcist Tsuchimikado Arima. After inviting the members of the dorm to the Five Mirror Chamber, he asks Rokuro and Benio to battle in front of exorcist authorities from around Japan. Benio wants to test Rokuro's strength, but he still wants nothing to do with being an exorcist.

3.o: Benio quickly becomes the center of attention after transferring to Rokuro and Mayura's middle school. When a Kegare attacks between classes, Benio decides to leave while Rokuro claims that their studies should take precedence over exorcist duties. But is that how he really feels?

4.t: The Sound of Magano - Bothersome Twosome
4.o: When Ryogo runs into more trouble than expected during a Kegare exorcism, a desperate Rokuro turns to the one person he thinks can really help: Benio.

5.t: Twelve Guardians, Vermilion Bird - The Guardian Shimon
5.o: When the kids from an elementary school soccer team are suddenly transported to Magano by Kegare, Rokuro joins Benio, Atsushi, and Shinnosuke to go to Magano and save them. But in the middle of the battle, painful memories overwhelm Rokuro, and he's unable to fight. Just then, one of the highest ranking Exorcists, the "Vermilion Bird" of the Twelve Guardians, Ikaruga Shimon, appears.

6.o: With Benio constantly leaving school for no given reason, Mayura starts to worry about her new classmate. And Rokuro starts getting back into the swing of things by joining the others on a regular Kegare exorcism.

7.o: Arima returns to Tokyo to give the Twin Star Exorcists a trial to test their skills. But it's not the kind of test they were anticipating, with an unexpected reward.

8.o: Mayura and Benio debate whether or not Rokuro should continue fighting, and an unpleasant figure from Rokuro's past arrives to test his renewed dedication to being an exorcist.

9.t: Intertwining Tragedies - Tragedy Comes With Smile
9.o: With the truth about Rokuro exposed to Benio, the Twin Star Exorcists are confronted by someone who shares a connection to both of them.

10.o: After being confronted by Yuuto, the Twin Star Exorcists are desperate to get stronger in preparation for future battles, but Benio's old master Subaru has a different kind of training in mind.

11.t: Do Your Best, Newlyweds - Fantastic Moments
11.o: Subaru of the Twelve Guardians thinks that Benio and Rokuro need to understand each other better, but the Twin Star Exorcists aren't convinced and insist on conventional combat training. The debate comes to head in the form of a game of hide and seek: if Benio and Rokuro can track Subaru down before sunset, she'll provide the training they're asking for.

12.t: Give Me a Break - Basara Boy Kamui
12.o: Benio and Rokuro square off against the massively powerful Kamui, but are hopelessly outmatched. What makes this Kegare so uniquely dangerous? And can the Twin Star Exorcists survive?

13.t: Your Courage, My Courage - Zero Millimeters Apart
13.o: Benio has a vendetta against the incredibly powerful Basara, Kamui. Rokuro tries to reason with her as she insists on fighting him no matter what the cost. Can the Twin Star Exorcists overcome their most deadly enemy yet by working together?

14.t: Yukatas, Stars and Wishes - Tanabata Special
14.o: It's Tanabata at the Seika Dorm, and everyone is reminiscing while they think about what their wishes for the future will be.

15.t: Goodbye to Being Alone - The Awakening of Love
15.o: Ryogo gets introduced to an attractive young exorcist by Fushihara, an exorcist from the neighboring area, causing him to question whether or not exorcists should pursue romantic relationships in face of the otherworldly threats that menace their lives.

16.t: As an Exorcist - Salvation Then Wailing
16.o: After harsh words from Seigen, the Twin Stars are frustrated with how powerless they feel. Mayura decides to help cheer her exorcist friends up, in spite of a warning from her father...

17.t: The Red Emblem Master Gave Me - New Talisman From Master
17.o: Seigen attacks Yuuto, which proves useless. Yuuto fatally wounds Seigen who casts a barrier around the Twin Star Exorcists and the fainted Mayura. Seigen resolves to blow himself up; however, Rokuro and Benio escape from inside the barrier, which again Yuuto congratulates. Seigen is saved minus one arm and Rokuro manages to land a punch on Yuuto who is shocked. He then announces that he will wait for Rokuro's answer (whether he will join Yuuto on the dark side) at a place where there are precious memories for the both of them: Hiinatsuki Dormitory. Seigen and Mayura were hospitalized: Seigen u

18.t: On the Eve of Battle - Triumph Over Fear
18.o: Rokuro has sworn to defeat Yuto. But... how? The Twin Star Exorcists look at the facts and try to find a way to strengthen their odds against an opponent that outclasses them in nearly every way.

19.t: Both Sin and Impurity - The 10 Seconds Decision
19.o: It's all been leading up to this. With their new Resonance abilities, the Twin Star Exorcists take the fight directly to Ijika Yuto. Will it be enough to defeat the twisted, evil exorcist?

20.t: Our Path - To the Future with Us Two
20.o: Yuto has been dominating the Twin Star Exorcists so far, but can help from an unexpected source change the course of their battle? (Note: This episode is the point where the anime fully diverges from the manga)

21.t: Rebirth of the Twin Stars - Sweetie Fairy
21.o: Two years have passed since their battle with Yuto, and the Twin Star Exorcists have gotten better with age. But when they find something unexpected in Magano, there's no telling what it could mean for their future.

22.t: It's Impure, Yknow? - Philosophical Filthy Seraphim
22.o: The hellish world of Magano, home of the Kegare, has begun to leak into our reality. Can the Twin Star Exorcists stop the growing influence before it spells doom for the town of Narukami?

23.t: Westward, Twin Stars - Hard To Be Mother
23.o: The Twin Stars head out of town to seal a Dragon Spot, and Benio is confronted with the infamy caused by her brother.

24.t: The Kegare's Dream - What Is Beautiful?
24.o: The Twin Stars' tour across Japan to seal the Kegare-spawning Dragon Spots makes a detour to an amusement park, and Sae makes a new friend that Benio and Rokuro aren't happy about.

25.o: The Twin Stars head down to Nagoya and encounter a baseball stadium that has been taken over by a Basara.

26.t: Twin Stars VS Twins - Basara Twins' Strings
26.o: The Twin Star Exorcists meet a pair of twin Basara brothers, whose teamwork might be a match for our heroes' powers... And the mastermind behind the Dragon Spots finally reveals himself.

27.o: While the Twin Stars tour Japan, Mayura tries to step up her skills as an exorcist.

28.o: A Dragon Spot in Kumano results in a brief detour before the Twin Stars and Sae arrive in Kyoto, and they meet the strongest member of the Twelve Guardians.

29.t: A Promise with Sae - Missing Exorcist Master
29.o: The head of the Exorcist Union is attacked by the Basara responsible for the the Dragon Spots. And the Twin Star Exorcists finally learn just where Sae came from.

30.o: With the secret behind the Dragon Spots and Sae's origin revealed, the path to salvation is clear. But are the Twin Stars willing to part ways with the girl who's become like a daughter to them? And if they're not, can they help the Twelve Guardians resist the flood of Kegare coming through the Dragon Spot?

31.t: Because I'm With You - Wai Wa Kinako Ya!
31.o: Kinako wakes up alone in the Seika Dorm after the trip to Kyoto. As he searches for Benio, he reminisces about how they first met.

32.t: Into Chaos - Seeking the Past, Seeking the Future
32.o: The Twin Stars reflect on their past, and Rokuro begins to question his own origins.

33.t: The Master Repays a Favor - I Want You to Eat Me
33.o: Kuranashi prepares the next phase of his plan, and sends the Basara who have allied with him to take on the Twelve Guardians.

34.t: The Greatest Duo?! - Wachi vs Washi & Watashi
34.o: Two of the Twelve Guardians, Zeze Miku and Sada Sakura, take on the ravenous Basara named Moro.

35.t: The Puppeteer's Revenge - I Am Not Alone
35.o: A Basara is targetting the Twin Star Exorcists, and the only one standing in his way is Shimon. But will the winged guardian save Rokuro and Benio, or be their ultimate downfall?

36.t: What Must Be Protected - What Is Really Important?
36.o: Chijiwa has wrapped Shimon, along with the rest of the school, in his marionette strings to force them to attack the Twin Stars. Can Rokuro, Benio, and Mayura find a way to free their friends, or will they be forced to fight?

37.t: Spirits Soaring in the City of Romance - Tell Me Honest Feelings
37.o: It's the quiet before the storm as the Twin Stars and their friends have a moment of rest before Kuranashi unleashes his plot.

38.t: Narukami's Most Ill-Fated Day - No Way To Run, No Place To Hide
38.o: Kuranashi unveils his deadly game, and if the Twin Star Exorcists don't win, it could mean the death of everyone in the town of Narukami.

39.t: The Sacred Beast of Love - Daughter's Fight! Father's Delight
39.o: Mayura and Seigen face off against Kuranashi, but the Basara has a wicked trick up his sleeve. Does the daughter-father team stand a chance against the mastermind of the attack on Narukami?

40.t: Twin Stars' Hearts Dance - Finally They Kissed?
40.o: The Twin Star Exorcists fight the giant Kegare ravaging Narukami while it floats in the sky, as the Twelve Guardians try to make sure the floating city can return to the ground safely.

41.t: The Twelve Guardians Fall! - Have a Nice Nightmare, 12 Guardians
41.o: With the Twelve Guardians caught in Kuranashi's trap, it's now up to the Twin Star Exorcists to free them. But what chance do they stand against the newly powerful Basara?

42.t: I Come From Magano - Say It Ain't So, Rokuro!
42.o: The threat Kuranashi had posed is over, but the Twin Stars don't get to celebrate for long when an old foe returns.

43.o: Rokuro is reeling from what he has learned about his past, and Head Exorcist Arima explains the full scope of what Abe no Seimei set in motion, over a thousand years ago.

44.t: Distanced Despite Their Love - Farewell My Precious
44.o: After learning about his true nature from Arima, and what it could potentially mean for the entire world, Rokuro makes a decision.

45.t: The Couple Alone - Lonely Twin Exorcist
45.o: Rokuro has decided to fight Yuto alone. Without Benio, and with the other higher ranked exorcists out of commission, does he stand a chance?

46.o: As they battle over the fate of the world, Yuto reveals the nature of his obsession with Rokuro.

47.o: Rokuro has become the Cataclysm King, and will soon be responsible for cleansing nearly all of humanity from the Earth. Abe no Seimei offers Benio a way to turn him back to normal, but at what cost?

48.o: Abe no Seimei is about to create his perfect new world, and it means a gruesome end for the our current one. I

49.o: Rokuro attempts to save Benio but even if he succeeds, can the Twin Star Exorcists prevent the creation of Abe no Seimei's new world?

50.o: The greatest Exorcist of all time intends to wipe humanity's yin away in order to create a world where there will be no more free will, or individuality. Can the Twin Star Exorcists stop him?

1.o: مزيج العراقة والحداثة الإيطالية هو سر حصول مطعم "أوستريا فرانسيسكانا" لصاحبه الشيف "ماسيمو بوتورا" على لقب ثالث أفضل مطعم في العالم.

2.o: يخوض "دان باربر" الشيف ذائع الصيت والمزارع المتفاني وأحد مبدعي الطهي، معركة من أجل تغيير طريقة تفكيرنا في الطعام وزراعته.

3.o: بين جزر "باتاغونيا" المنعزلة ومطاعم "ميشلين" الفرنسية الممتازة، يستمتع الشيف "فرانسيس مالمان" بطريقة طهيه الجامحة على منقل الشوي.

4.o: في مطعمهما "إن/ناكا" بلوس أنجلوس والحائز على عدة جوائز، تتساوى "نيكي ناكاياما" في الإبداع والشغف والخبرة عند تحضيرها لأطعمة مطبخ الكايسيكي.

5.o: شغف الشيف النيوزيلندي "بن شوري" العميق بالطبيعة وتفانيه في البحث عن مذاقات جديدة يمنحان مطعمه "أتيكا" شهرة عالمية ذائعة الصيت.

6.o: بعيدًا عن أي مدينة وبعيدًا عن وجود المكونات الطازجة، يؤسس الشيف "ماغنوس نيلسون" مطعمه الرائع في مدينة "جاربن" المتجمدة بالسويد.

1.o: يريد النجم الأمريكي الطاهي "غرانت آكاتز" إبهار رواد مطعمه بالغموض والعواطف والسحر، كما يفعل بالنكهات والجمال.

2.o: من خلال روحه الجامحة وحبه لأدغال منطقة الأمازون، يبرهن الطاهي والمغامر البرازيلي "أليكس أتالا" لرواد مطعمه أن الانفتاح ينعكس على المذاق.

3.o: حب "دومينيك" المولودة في فرنسا للحياة والعائلة والعلاقات الشخصية ساعدها على أن تصبح أول طاهية تحوز على نجمتي "ميشلان" في أمريكا.

4.o: يحوّل الطاهي "إنريكي أوليفيرا" أطعمة شوارع المكسيك اللذيذة وذات المكونات التقليدية إلى أطباق فائزة بجوائز في مطعمه في مكسيكو سيتي.

5.o: تستخدم الطاهية السلوفينية "آنا روز"، التي علّمت نفسها بنفسها، المكونات المنتقاة من المناطق النائية لصنع أطباق ملهمة ومثيرة للدهشة.

6.o: مدفوعًا بشغفه في إعادة رسم صورة الطعام الهندي التقليدي؛ أنشأ الطاهي المشهور "غاغان أناند" أفضل مطعم في قارة آسيا بأكلمها.

1.o: في كوريا الجنوبية، تمارس الراهبة البوذية "جونغ كوان" الطهي كنشاط روحي، لكن وجباتها أثارت انبهار أفضل كبار الطهاة حول العالم.

2.o: في مطعم "وايت رابيت" في موسكو، يقدّم الطاهي "فلاديمير موكين" الروح الحقيقية للمطبخ الروسي بتقديم الأطباق التقليدية بلمسة عصرية.

3.o: يدفع هوس العجين الطاهية "نانسي سيلفرتون" من لوس أنجلوس والحائزة على جائزة إلى بناء إمبراطورية صناعة الخبز قبل تحولها إلى خبيرة موتزاريلا.

4.o: أدّت قصة حبّه لليابان، والتي استمرّت لعقود، إلى أن يصبح الطاهي "آيفان أوركن" من نيويورك طاهيًا محترفًا للرامن... والأومامي.

5.o: بعد فترة مراهقة مضطربة في شوارع برلين، أثار الطاهي "تيم روا" عالم الطهي في المدينة بالفوز بنجمتين في دليل "ميشلان" بنكهات جديدة.

6.o: باستخدامه لمكونات غيرمعروفة من بيرو، يبتكر الطاهي "فيرغيليو مارتينيز" أنظمة بيئية رائعة صالحة للأكل في قائمته المبتكرة في "سنترال".

1.o: في "ميلك بار" الشهير في نيويورك، تجسّد "كرستينا توسي" عشقها للوجبات السريعة بوجباتٍ لا تقاوم، كالبوظة بحليب حبوب الإفطار وفطيرة الكوكايين.

2.o: يستمدّ "كورادو اسينزا" الإلهام من نشأته في بساتين صقلية ومزارعها، ليحضّر ألذّ أنواع البوظة والغرانيتا باللوز والكانولي المقرمشة وغيرها.

3.o: عندما شاءت الأقدار أن يصير "جوردي روكا" مسؤولًا عن المعجنات في مطعم أخويه الشهير، أبهر الجميع بإبداعاته المبتكرة.

4.o: بعد أن صار "ويل غولدفارب" مشهورًا بسبب حلوياته المبتكرة، غادر نيويورك فجأة ليبدأ بداية جديدة في "بالي"، حيث الكاكاو والفانيلا الطازجين.

1.o: مُستعينة بتقليد عائلتها العريق في إعداد الـ"بارباكوا"، تصبح "كريستينا مارتينيز" نجمة طهي في "فيلادلفيا"، ومدافعة عن المهاجرين غير الشرعيين.

2.o: في مطعم "تشيا" في "إسطنبول"، يُعيد "موسى داغديفيرن"، عالِم أنثروبولوجيا الطعام، ابتكار أطباق محليّة تركيّة في محاولة منه لحفظها من الفناء.

3.o: تشعر "بو سونغفيسافا" بالإحباط لندرة الطعام التايلاندي الأصلي، فتعيد إحياء النكهات المحليّة القويّة والمعقّدة في مطعمها المستدام في "بانكوك".

4.o: بعدما عمل لسنوات مديرًا إبداعيًّا في مطعم "إل بولي"، يرأس "ألبرت أدريا" حاليًا "مدينة مَلاهٍ" تضمّ سلسلة مطاعم مختلفة في "برشلونة".

1.o: في محطة حافلات سابقة من زمن العنصرية في "سافانا"، جورجيا، تكرّم "ماشاما بايلي" ذكرى التاريخ بإضفاء لمسة جديدة على تقاليد المأكولات الجنوبية.

2.o: تناول الجزّار التوسكاني الجذّاب "داريو شيكيني" خلال طفولته كل أجزاء البقرة عدا شرائح اللحم... والآن هو في مهمّة لتغيير رأي العالم في اللحوم.

3.o: خلال رحلتها غير المتوقّعة من غلاميّة الطبع في "كالكوتا" إلى طاهية مشهورة في لندن، تحطّم "آسما خان" الأعراف وتخلق فرصًا جديدة للنساء.

4.o: مدفوعًا بالهوس والسعي وراء الكمال وإدمان العمل، يعيد "شون بروك" إحياء المذاقات المنسيّة بتفانٍ ليجدّد المطبخ الجنوبي... لكنّه كاد يقضي عليه.

1.o: Genius entrepreneur Oh Soo can astutely read people's emotions and uses that ability and a dash of magic to help bring people together in love. But what will he do when one of his connections ends up with a broken heart?

2.o: Yoo Ri suffers heartache and humiliation, and experiences another chance encounter with Oh Soo. Meanwhile, Oh Soo's destiny comes to confront him in the light of his grandpa's disappearance.

3.o: Grandpa sends Ga Nah to spy on Oh Soo. Oh Soo learns some personal information about Yoo Ri.

4.o: Yoo Ri is surprised to find out who Soo Jung's homeroom teacher is. Oh Soo learns the secret of the suitcase.

5.o: Yoo Ri returns the stolen bag to its rightful owner. Oh Soo becomes jealous.

6.o: Yoo Ri is mortified when Jin Woo takes her to Oh Soo's cafe.

7.o: Yoo Ri doesn't know what to do when Oh Soo asks her out. Will she give him a chance?

8.o: When Yoo Ri's mom needs help, Jin Woo is there to help. Oh Soo goes to Germany for business.

9.o: Oh Soo finds a couple he can help, but it doesn't go quite the way he expected.

10.o: Yoo Ri feels more and more uncomfortable. Oh Soo realizes that she has started to avoid him.

11.o: Grandpa is shocked but happy when Ga Nah tells him that Oh Soo has a girlfriend.

12.o: When Yoo Ri ends up in the ER, both Oh Soo and Jin Woo show up to take care of her.

13.o: Oh Soo wonders what will happen to Yoo Ri now. He confides in her in Japanese, not knowing that she is proficient in Japanese.

14.o: Scared of the power of the Law of the Tree, Oh Soo considers moving to Germany.

15.o: Oh Soo explains the Law of the Tree to Yoo Ri.

16.o: In the series finale, the origin of the tree is finally explained. Can Oh Soo break the curse?

1.o: في شمال إيطاليا، تستمتع "سامين" بالخصائص السحريّة لزيت الزيتون ودهن الخنزير والجبن في أثناء زيارتها للمزارع ومساعدتها في إعداد أطباق محليّة.

2.o: ما بين الملح البحريّ وصلصة الصويا وحساء الـ"ميسو"، تكشف رحلة إلى اليابان أشكال الملح المتعدّدة، وتأثيراتها البالغة في الأطعمة.

3.o: تستعرض "سامين" القوّة التحويليّة للأحماض في زيارتها لـ"يوكاتان"، حيث يضيف البرتقال الحامض والصلصات وعسل شعب "المايا" أبعادًا جديدةً لكل طبق.

4.o: تعود "سامين" إلى موطنها في كاليفورنيا وتستخدم الحرارة في تحمير اللحم والخضار وإكسابها ألوانًا ونكهات قويّة، ثم تطهو أرزًا مُقرمشًا مع أمّها.

1.o: Ted gets his chance to be on TV when he is to be interviewed by a magazine programme. But 'FunLand', the most pathetic travelling fair ever conceived has come to Craggy Island, and while Ted is distracted with Father Jack, Dougal seizes his moment of glory.

2.o: The world's most boring priest comes to stay, and he just won't go away. After his worst ever birthday party, Father Ted prays for deliverance from Father Stone, but a lightning strike wasn't what he expected.

3.o: The local cinema is showing a film condemned by the Church for its X-rated and blasphemous depiction of Saint Tibulus. Bishop Brennan is dispatched to the island to ensure that the priests take to the picket line in protest. But their defiant stand only gives more publicity to the film, which becomes an overnight success. It is left to Father Jack to stop the Bishop from sending them packing.

4.o: It's the 'All Priests Stars In Their Eyes Lookalike Competition', and showbusiness personality Henry Sellers, a former alcoholic, has landed on the island to host the festivities. Father Ted is determined not to go as Mother Teresa again, but he isn't the only one to think of Elvis. It takes some quick thinking to beat Father Byrne's team from nearby Rugged Island.

5.o: A blossoming romance between Father Ted and steamy novelist Polly Clarke threatens to come between a group of visiting nuns and their favourite priest. Among other things, Ted delivers an entire service in a matter of milliseconds, and becomes involved in an armed robbery.

6.o: After an overdose of floor polish, Father Jack finally bites the dust, and Ted and Dougal discover they've been left a fortune in his will - providing they allay his fear of being buried alive by spending a night with him in the crypt.

1.o: Ted, Dougal and Jack go on an all-expenses-spared holiday to Kilkelly Caravan Park. They meet a young couple, and are soon in trouble with the police. Entertainment comes in the shape of St Kevin's Stump and the Magic Road. Father Jack goes missing; Father Noel Furlong and his youth group turn up to put the final nail in the coffin of the holiday.

2.o: The roof of the Parochial House is leaking, and Ted decides on a raffle to raise the funds, with a car as the prize. Unfortunately, an accident with a cyclist puts something of a dent in the vehicle. A similar car is borrowed from the Dancing Priest in order to save the raffle; however, the priests must then win in order to return the car. Despite this intrigue, the roof does not get repaired.

3.o: The Holy Stone of Clonrichert is to be upgraded to a class 2 relic, and unfortunately this entails three Bishops visiting the island - Father Jack must be housetrained quickly. Only one of the bishops dies - Ted therefore considers this to have been a relatively successful visit.

4.o: Ted goes on a picnic, Mr Benson's whistle is stolen and Dougal learns an important lesson about true friendship. Ted narrowly avoids incriminating himself to save Dougal's worthless hide

5.o: Fathers Ted and Dougal enter A Song For Europe with My Lovely Horse. The tune is stolen from the b-side of a Norwegian song that didn't even win A Song For Norway but the lyrics are all their own work. Somehow they get through to Eurovision and score.... nil points.

6.o: Rabbit-phobic Bishop Brennan pays a visit to investigate reports of Father Jack sleepwalking naked. Unfortunately Dougal has overrun the house with rabbits, and a Terry & June-style farce ensues as Ted and Dougal attempt to keep Father Jack in bed, and the ever-multiplying rabbits away from the bishop.

7.o: Ted is asked to judge the 'Lovely Girls' competition while Dougal is left in charge of the house. Father Jack is mistaken for Bob Geldof and Dougal manages to give the house away to a feminist rock star called Niamh Connolly. Ted has to get the house back, but how will this affect his dinner plans with the winner of the 'Lovely Girls' competition?

8.o: Ted and co. enter a giving-things-up-for-Lent contest and soon discover that abstinence is easier preached than done. Father Jack sobers up for the first time in years, but Dougal and Ted find their resolve wavering. To strengthen their vows Ted calls in a nun to supervise them. She turns out to be a sadist of the first water, and the results are inevitable.

9.o: After discovering Father Jack is suffering yet again(!) from "hairy hand syndrome," Ted is delighted to send Jack, by "doctor's orders," to St. Clabberts Old Folks Home (otherwise known as 'Jurassic Park'). Unfortunately, Jack's replacement happens to be one of the nastiest priests ever - Father Fintan Stack. Along with his disregard for the church, Stack has a rather irritating habit of playing jungle music loudly at 3 o'clock in the morning, and a plan is hatched to get Jack back to sort out Stack.

10.o: Ted and co. end up crammed in an aeroplane along with every other priest who has appeared in their lives after a visit to the Shrine of Kinlettle. In a usual fit of stupidity, Dougal manages to empty the fuel tanks on the plane. To make matters worse, there are only two parachutes, so Ted devises a way for the priests to compete for the parachutes. Unfortunately, Jack has other plans.

1.t: Are You Right There Father Ted?
1.o: Ted finally escapes to a new posting at Castlelawn Parochial House, Dublin, with civilised company and frequent jaunts to Paris. Unfortunately a slight misunderstanding over some expenses sends Ted back to his old compadres on the island. After a spot of lads' housecleaning results in Ted being mistakenly tarred as a racist, Ted holds a celebration of Chinese culture to clear his name - though 'Kung Fu Fighting' may not have been an inspired choice of soundtrack. Just when it looks like a happy ending might be in store, a mix-up over some soft furnishings and Nazi memorabilia leaves the Chines

2.o: Ted gets mixed up in a web of intrigue and double-cross when he bets the Parochial House heating budget on Chris, the burping sheep. The lads bring Chris to stay at the house in an attempt to improve his chances at 'King of the Sheep 98', but can Ted quell his burping in time for the great day?

3.o: Ted and Dougal turn detective to discover who's behind the bumper crop of hairy babies on Craggy Island. However when justice is done on the culprit he takes a terrible revenge. Dougal's moonlighting stint as island milkman is marred by a bomb set to go off if the milk float drops below 4mph. Does 'The Poseidon Adventure' hold the key to his rescue, or would Father Jack's pet brick come in more useful?

4.o: A perfectly routine trip to the mainland results in Dougal almost dying from malnutrition, Mrs Doyle being chucked in the clink, Ted nearly being beaten up by Victor Meldrew, and Father Jack joining Alcoholics Anonymous. A chance encounter with old friends Noel Furlong and the St. Luke's Youth Group in some spooky caves spells spelaeological trouble for our heroes.

5.o: It's the All-Priests Over-75s Five-A-Side Football challenge, and disaster looms when Ted's star player is nobbled by a bottle of Dreamy-Sleepy Nighty Snoozy-Snooze. Fortunately a pair of fake rubber arms and a remote-controlled wheelchair put our lads in with a chance of beating Dick Byrne this year. As long as they can fool the referee...

6.t: Kicking Bishop Brennan up the Arse
6.o: A lost bet with Dick Byrne means Ted has to kick Bishop Brennan up the arse. On cue, Len arrives with PA Father Jessup, the world's most sarcastic priest. Elaborate preparations, a camera, a skirting board, a set of watercolours and some psychological warfare on Ted's part ensure a successful outcome. Or do they?

7.o: Jumper-wearing pop sensation Eoin McLove comes to visit. Unfortunately his presence leads hundreds of infatuated middle-aged ladies to surround the house, and the usual hilarious mix-ups ensue. But McLove's easy-going stage persona masks a terrible secret.

8.o: Ted performs a genuinely unselfish act, and is rewarded with the offer of a parish in California - his wildest dreams come true. However, parting from his long-time companions at the Parochial House proves tricky. Unless Ted can break the news of his departure tactfully to Dougal, Jack and Mrs Doyle, he won't be going to America...

1.o: Danny’s world comes crashing down as Josh’s health deteriorates and death becomes a matter of time. An organ transplant is the only hope for Josh’s survival. Danny makes a dangerous commitment to himself and walks down a path of no return. Kabir cracks a nexus between a corrupt cop and a local drug cartel but in doing so exposes himself and his unit to public criticism on social media.

2.o: Danny starts researching on the organ donation process. After tracking down potential organ donors, Danny zeroes in on his first target, Verma and plots an unconventional way to bring Josh one step closer to survival. Kabir refuses to let go of his troubled memories as he and Ria face divorce.

3.o: Danny gets emboldened and selects his second target, the young techie Rahul. When Danny’s best-laid plan goes awry, he makes a desperate and brutal attempt. Kabir’s instinct leads him to begin an investigation into the case. Kabir and Prakash are convinced that there is more to Rahul’s accident than meets the eye.

4.o: Danny’s killing instincts get sharper as he picks his next target, aspiring actress Anita, and weaves a stealthy bid to entrap her. Kabir faces strong resistance from his new boss, ACP Shankar. Kabir and Prakash crack a vital clue that could prove to be the first link between the deaths of two unrelated organ donors. The duo discovers a startling pattern and a shocking target on the killer’s list.

5.o: Time is running out for Josh and Danny makes a bold entry into Ria’s world. He also puts his own life at risk in a bid to finish the job with Verma. Kabir struggles to manage both personal and professional fallout as he faces a roadblock that could end his investigation in the organ donors’ deaths. Kabir and Prakash zero-in on a new suspect, Rao and the heat on the case dials-up a notch.

6.o: An intense cat-and-mouse game begins as Kabir lands up at Danny’s home and the suspicion on Danny gets stronger. Shankar cracks down on Kabir’s moonlighting investigation and orders a shutdown even as Kabir pieces together the puzzle. Danny creates the perfect alibi as he makes a sly attempt on his next target, Nair.

7.o: Danny’s alibi turns out too well planned for Kabir to pin the murders down on him. Undeterred and as determined as ever, Danny moves to his next target even as Kabir shifts focus to Rao and his instincts lead him to a vital clue that could crack the case and indict Rao for the murders. A game of smoke screens begins between Kabir and Danny as Danny moves Josh one more step closer to survival.

8.o: With the case seemingly closed and Kabir’s attention diverted, Danny makes his boldest move yet – a direct attack on Ria to get the organ that would finally give Josh a normal life. When all seems to be going as per Danny’s plan, a stark and shocking revelation makes for a fitting final showdown in this series finale.

1.o: Rivette instantly establishes his playful, no-rules reality as two theater troupes rehearse avant-garde versions of Aeschylus plays climaxing in an epic, hypnotic warm-up exercise that unfolds like a primal, clothed orgy. We are introduced to a deadpan, deaf-mute busker and Frédérique, a wayward young con artist.

2.o: The outlines of a conspiracy begin to emerge as the busker begins receiving cryptic letters with references to Balzac and Lewis Carroll’s 'The Hunting of the Snark'. Meanwhile, rehearsals take an unsettling turn.

3.o: The mystery of the enigmatic notes deepens as the busker learns about their connection to Balzac’s 'History of the Thirteen'. Elsewhere, tensions flare up at rehearsals.

4.o: The various strands of the story begin to intersect. The busker continues on his quest to uncover the source of the cryptic letters, while Frédérique is also inadvertently drawn into the conspiracy. Games—cops and robbers, chess, and cons—abound.

5.o: Frédérique finds that blackmail doesn’t pay as she crosses paths with the busker who is now in love with Pauline—or is it Emilie? Meanwhile, a wild goose chase through Paris ensues when one of the productions is fleeced out of money.

6.o: Maps, symbols, codes, card games, and double meanings: the intrigue starts to accelerate.

7.o: Cracks in the conspiracy begin to appear and things really start to get confusing.

8.o: And then the narrative implodes...

1.o: Bollywood Superstar Romesh Raj is gearing up to a press conference to clear his name from linkups with the reigning star Sana Sanyal. But fate has plans of its own.

2.o: Romesh gets access to Sana's private files. What he finds there sends him into a spin of regrets and memories, as Sana fights for her life.

3.o: Sana's meeting with her father provokes in her the desire to be a bigger star than he is.

4.o: Romesh begin to regret his vengefulness towards Sana. Ranjit Thakur demands to meet Romesh when he finds out that Romesh's wife has leaked sensational information regarding Sana and Ranjit.

5.o: Ends and Beginnings: Sana's assaulter is discovered, and so are traumatic details from her past - will Romesh's opinion of her change?

6.o: Game of Control: Sana finds herself a victim of intimidation by producer Sandeep Jindal. Vishnu and Sana decide to seize control from him - they make a calculated plan to get back at him.

7.o: A New Love: Romesh finally admits his feelings for Sana. The notes from her past have moved him enough to visit her at her hospital. Will Sana accept him?

8.o: Foul Play: Romesh drops his plans to bring Sana down, and realises that all she was chasing was a drop of love. But will Sana come out of the hospital alive?

9.o: Not My Father - Sana creates a foul situation to make her father face the  fact that she is his illegitimate child. But will this be victory enough for her?.

10.o: Under The Spotlight - In the finale episode of Spotlight Romesh finally accepts his love for Sana. Sana is able to redeem herself in everyone's eyes and continue on her dizzying journey to stardom.

1.o: A producer is awaiting the music recording of his film to begin. But the singer has not arrived. The singer's manager is forced by the producer to find the artist and bring him to the recording.

2.o: Vicky gets into a physical fight with Anubhav as Vicky accuses Anubhav of selfishness and not having Vicky's best interests in mind.

3.o: Anubhav informs Vicky that Deeya had wanted to meet him. Vicky feels encouraged that perhaps Deeya wants to meet him and apologise.

4.o: Vicky is sent to a lockup overnight. The media finds out and throngs the police station. Vicky’s lawyer and Anubhav rush to bail him out.

5.o: Jo lets Vicky stay in the guest bedroom of her house. She checks all his belongings thoroughly to see if there are any drugs and throws away some cocaine joints she finds.

6.o: Jo finds out. She gets really angry to know Vicky has broken the terms of their contract. But she decides to play it smart. She behaves like she has no clue Vicky has used drugs.

7.o: Nisha decides not to engage further with Vicky since she realises it is not good for him. Meanwhile, Deeya is not having too much success with her protegee whom she hoped would be her replacement for Vicky.

8.o: Vicky is unable to digest the fact that Jo has a fiance. It is awkward for him. He offers to move out of her house to give them some privacy but Jo insists that Vicky and she are friends - and Rahul is the fiance - there is no awkwardness for her.

9.o: Deeya is going mad in her office breaking things down in rage after watching Vicky in news. Deeya walks in angry to meet her father. She argues with him and asks him to explain the situation. Vicky is recording the viral hit on the streets and Abhinav give this news to others.

10.o: Street video becomes a hit viral video in the social media, Jyotika, Vicky, Abhinav and Ronu are celebrating for Vicky's come back in the industry, one sad song placement on Vicky and Jyotika’s situation.

11.o: Vicky did manage to complete a new song and he has got a new 5 city tour as well, but here Jyotika agrees with Rahul about going to London with him, Vicky wants Jyotika to come on this tour and she convinces Rahul to join her on a tour, Deeya is planning last strategy to ruin Vicky’s name.

12.o: Rahul gets some emergency meeting back in Mumbai and he needs to leave. Vicky gets flash back about him and Jyotika's good moments. Vicky snaps out of the memory of the past and is in tears as he says to himself, during music rehearsal Jyotika comes and asks Vicky to have a private conversation.

13.o: Vicky is in the hospital and Jyotika is in panic mode and she is crying and worried about Vicky. Doctor explains about Vicky's throat injuries, he says someone did this intentionally so that he cannot sing. Jyotika takes out her anger on Deeya at her office, Vicky wants to perform anyhow.

1.o: The Truth and the Mirage is an Egyptian series produced by Media Production City. This series revolves around a wealthy, authoritarian woman, played by actress Fifi Abdo.

1.t: When the Doorman Is Your Main Man
1.o: “Ours was a common and unsung friendship, that between women living in New York, single and alone, and the doormen who take care of them, acting as gatekeepers, bodyguards, confidants and father figures.”

2.t: When Cupid Is a Prying Journalist
2.o: “I tossed out one last question: ‘Have you ever been in love?’ No one, he said, had ever asked him that in an interview. ‘Yes,’ he finally answered. ‘But I didn’t realize it until it was too late.’ Then he asked me to turn off my recorder. I hit Stop."

3.t: Take Me as I Am, Whoever I Am
3.o: “My personal life was another story. In love there’s no hiding: You have to let someone know who you are, but I didn’t have a clue who I was from one moment to the next.”

4.t: Rallying to Keep the Game Alive
4.o: “We rallied, not with the adrenaline-pumping determination to win at all costs, but with the patience and control that came with not wanting it to be over: not the summer, not our son’s childhood, not this game, ever.”

5.t: At the Hospital, an Interlude of Clarity
5.o: “There is never a good time to fall off your couch onto a martini glass and begin losing a dangerous amount of blood, but having this happen in the middle of a promising date is an especially bad time.”

6.t: So He Looked Like Dad. It Was Just Dinner, Right?
6.o: “He was very handsome. He wore gray turtleneck sweaters and smelled like mint aftershave and old books. He was 55 and recently divorced for the second time. He was my father. He wasn't really my father.”

7.t: Hers Was a World of One
7.o: “There was no guarantee that doing an open adoption would get us a baby any faster… in fact, our agency warned us that, as a gay male couple, we might be in for a long wait.”

8.t: The Race Grows Sweeter Near Its Final Lap
8.o: “Old love is different. In our 70s and 80s, we had been through enough of life’s ups and downs to know who we were, and we had learned to compromise. The finish line was drawing closer.”

1.t: On a Serpentine Road, With the Top Down
1.o: "Driving, with the top down, I’m reminded that I too can shift gears, face risk, handle inconvenience — and survive tragedy. My partner, eyes misting, says: 'You love that car. And your husband was an extraordinary man.'"

2.t: The Night Girl Finds a Day Boy
2.o: "I'm a vampire, basically — going to bed around 8 or 9 a.m. and waking around 4 or 5 p.m. First dates usually go OK because they’re in the evening, but complications quickly arise."

3.o: "We met on a train. A perfect, flirtatious, six hours. The beginning of our love story? Trusting in the power of the universe, we hadn’t exchanged mobile numbers. Sometimes, a romantic plan isn’t enough."

4.t: A Life Plan for Two, Followed By One
4.o: "He was everything a 10-year-old girl could ever hope for in a man. It was decided; I was in love. I started to wonder if the glow from my wedding dress would make him look washed-out. I began devising a plan in which he and I would end up '2gether 4ever,' as all my notebooks stated."

5.t: Am I ...? Maybe This Quiz Will Tell Me
5.o: "In retrospect, maybe I should have known who I was the first time I went looking for a quiz called 'Am I gay?' But I didn’t."

6.t: In the Waiting Room of Estranged Spouses
6.o: "A few months later, I was in the psychologist’s reception room, paying for my fourth really good cry, when a woman carrying a child walked in. I didn’t recognize her at first, and then I remembered her face. 'Are you the wife of the guy my wife is having an affair with?' I asked tactlessly. 'Yeah,' she said. 'But we’re not together anymore.'"

7.o: "I don’t remember his last name. He was handsome, with a nice smile and startlingly blue eyes. The sex was good, I think. We didn’t know each other well. We never would."

8.t: A Second Embrace, with Hearts and Eyes Open
8.o: "On this night, long after we had thrown in the towel on us, here we were again, crawling back into the ring. This time, though, it would be different. We just never imagined how different it would become, or how quickly."

1.o: An interactive element emerges to see what makes humans' sexual psyches hum. Hot dancing? Uniforms? Sperm samples will be collected.

2.t: The Best Age to Be Alive
2.o: The hosts make surprising discoveries when 20-, 30-, 40-, 50- and 60-somethings compete against each other in assembling furniture and other tests.

3.o: The battle of the sexes goes under a microscope as the participants disprove multiple myths and confirm others. The experts examine the results.

4.o: Ingrained bias sneaks in, prompting subjects to judge others by their accents, fire toy guns at innocent bystanders and underrate their own peers.

5.o: Humans weigh pleasurable prizes against painful penalties as the hosts explore the many ways negative and positive elements shape our reality.

6.o: The subjects pursue joy through crafts and catastrophes, partying and watching paint dry. Time flies when they’re having fun, except when it doesn't.

7.o: Go with your gut? Not always. The hosts learn how noses, eyes and even taste buds are impacted by context and external forces like music — and mimes.

8.o: Time for the big questions, as chosen by the humans themselves. How common are heroes? Do names matter? Above all, what’s proper toilet etiquette?

1.o: مطلّقة ثرية توظّف مدرّب كرة القدم الأمريكية "تيد لاسو" لتدريب فريق كرة القدم الإنكليزي لنادي "ريتشموند".

2.o: إنه يوم "تيد" الأول في التدريب، والمشجعون ليسوا سعداء. لا يتقدّم كثيراً لكنه لم يرتدع مع لعب الفريق للمباراة الأولى.

3.o: للترتيب لكشف الستار عن الحقيقة، تدبّر "ريبيكا" لقاءً بين الصحافي المتشائم "ترينت كريم" و"تيد" على مدار يوم. "تيد" و"روي" ينخرطان في أنشطة مجتمعية.

4.o: تستضيف "ريبيكا" الحفل الخيري السنوي للفريق، حيث يرتّب "تيد" مصالحة بين "روي" و"جايمي".

5.o: بمجيء زوجته وابنه من "أمريكا"، يجري "تيد" تغييرات جذرية لتشكيل الفريق في أثناء مباراة حاسمة.

6.o: عندما يرفض "جايمي" التدرّب، يتجه "تيد" إلى لاعب موهوب جديد "داني روهاس"، وتصيب الفريق لعنة قديمة.

7.o: تحتفل "ريبيكا" بالذكرى السنوية الأولى لها كمطلقة في أثناء لعب الفريق مباراة في "ليفربول".

8.o: يواجه كلا من "تيد" و"روي" مشكلة في علاقتهما. يستشير "تيد" "دياموند دوغز" بينما "روي" يتحدث إلى "كيلي" بصراحة.

9.o: بعد سلسلة من الأخطاء في الملعب، يصل الضغط إلى ذروته باستبعاد "روي". تعلن "ريبيكا" عن مفاجأة.

10.o: يلعب نادي "ريتشموند" مباراة قمة ستحدد مصير "تيد" وناديه.

1.o: نادي "ريتشموند" يحضر اختصاصية نفسية رياضية لتساعد الفريق على التغلب على سلسلة التعادلات المتتالية غير المسبوقة في 7 مباريات.

2.o: يتفاجأ "تيد" بعودة وجه مألوف. و"روي" يجرّب عملاً جديداً.

3.o: تزور "ريبيكا" ضيفة مميزة وترافقها في العمل. والفريق لا يرحب بعودة أحد اللاعبين.

4.o: حان وقت عيد الميلاد المجيد في "ريتشموند". "ريبيكا" تجنّد "تيد" من أجل مهمة سرية، و"روي" و"كيلي" يبحثان عن معجزة، وأسرة "هيغنز" تفتح بيتها.

5.o: يتعلم "نايت" الحزم من "ريبيكا" و"كيلي". و"تيد" يطلب خدمة من "روي".

6.o: يبتهج "تيد" لأن شكل الفريق الجديد يبدو ناجعاً، لكن هل سيحظى الفريق بفرصة في ربع النهائي؟

7.o: بعد تحسّن الأوضاع في "ريتشموند"، حان الوقت ليجتهد الجميع في حل مشكلاته، مثل قلق "تيد"، وثقة "نايت"، وانتباه "روي".

8.o: يدرك "تيد" والدكتورة "شارون" أن عليهما أن يتفاهما. والتوتر عال مع استعداد الفريق لنصف النهائي.

9.o: بعد نصف النهائي، ينطلق "بيرد" في ملحمة ليلية عبر "لندن" محاولاً جمع شتات أفكاره.

10.o: تشعر "ريبيكا" بصدمة بعد خسارة مفاجئة. يجتمع الفريق ليظهر دعمه، لكن "تيد" يجد نفسه في صراع مع جزء من ماضيه.

11.o: مشجع كرة قدم ملياردير من "غانا" يقدّم عرضاً كبيراً لـ"سام"، و"تيد" يخطط لشيء مميز لآخر يوم للدكتورة "شارون" مع الفريق.

12.o: تسنح لـ"ريتشموند" فرصة الصعود ثانية إلى الدوري الممتاز، بينما يواجه "تيد" تداعيات مقالة "ترينت كريم" المؤلمة.

1.o: نادي "ريتشموند" المتأهل حديثاً يواجه استهزاء من المحلّلين إذ يتنبؤون بأن ينهوا الموسم في المركز الأخير.

2.t: (I Don't Want to Go to) Chelsea
2.o: صدور أنباء عن رغبة لاعب كبير في الانتقال إلى "لندن"، ما يصيب الأندية الإنكليزية بحالة هيجان. و"ريتشموند" يخوضون أولى مبارياتهم بعد العودة إلى الدوري الممتاز.

3.o: "ريتشموند" يتكيفون مع تغيير مثير، لكن لدى "جايمي" تحفظات. و"تيد" يكتشف أحداثاً جديدة جارية في "كانساس" أيضاً.

4.o: الجميع يشعر بالضغط إذ يتحضّر "ريتشموند" للقاء "وست هام". ويلتمّ شمل "تيد" بصديق قديم.

5.o: مع تأزم موسمهم، يحاول "ريتشموند" تصحيح المسار ضد "مانشستر سيتي" العظيم. وخارج الملعب، يواجه الجميع انتكاساته الخاصة.

6.o: مباراة ودية تأخذ الفريق إلى "أمستردام"، حيث يكتشف الكثيرون حقائق خفية بعد قضاء سهرة بالخارج.

7.o: "غرايهاوندز" يجرّبون استراتيجية جديدة تجعل الجميع يفكر خارج الصندوق. و"سام" يستعد لاستضافة ضيف مميز في "أولاس".

8.o: أثناء مشاهدة "هنري"، يقاوم "تيد" الرغبة الحثيثة في الانهيار حين تسافر "ميشيل" والدكتور "جايكوب" في رحلة رومانسية. وتسريب عبر الإنترنت له تداعيات مهولة على "كيلي".

9.o: صداقة "كولين" و"أيزاك" تتعرّض إلى اختبار. و"روي" يتلقى طلباً بحضور مؤتمر صحافي.

10.o: بينما يتوجه بعض الـ"غرايهاوندز" إلى أوطانهم للمشاركة في صفوف منتخبات بلادهم بمباريات دولية، يطرح "إدوين أكوفو" مقترحاً تجارياً على "ريبيكا".

11.o: ضيفة غير متوقعة توتّر أعصاب "تيد". وحين يسافر "ريتشموند" إلى "مانشستر" من أجل مباراة مهمة، يقلق "روي" و"كيلي" على "جايمي".

3.o: Still reeling from a shocking death, Kanan pushes his way into the drug game with Marvin’s help while Raq plots to take down her competition.

6.o: Raq assures everyone they need to follow orders and keep working as planned. Kanan takes on more responsibility but things go wrong when he runs into neighborhood kids. Lou feels the pressure in his partnership with Crown.

7.o: Raq searches for a new home. Lou finds himself on the other side of his partner's unpaid debts. Burke gains traction in her investigation on Howard. A botched agreement with Marvin and an associate threatens everything.

8.t: A HOUSE IS NOT A HOME

9.o: With his living situation threatened, Famous reaches out to Lou as a last-ditch effort. Raq receives a new business proposal and must eliminate a threat. Burke closes in on what really happened in Baisley Park.

10.o: Decidedly his own man, Kanan strays further from his mother and sets up shop on his own on the corners of South Jamaica. Worried about retaliation, Raq questions Unique. Lou's rift with Raq grows when he makes a discovery.

1.o: Raq makes a life-changing decision in the aftermath of the Mafia’s ambush, but its too little, too late for Kanan, as he looks to pave his own path free of his mother’s lies.

2.o: Raq continues her farewell tour with one last job for the Mafia while Kanan dives further into the drug game with an innovative business idea. Howard faces a new threat at the precinct.

3.o: As paranoia sets in for Raq and Howard over the Task Force, Kanan and Famous launch their weed delivery business, Jukebox prepares for her audition, and Ronnie grows impatient with Unique.

4.o: New business ventures take shape for the Thomas family, but the outlook is bleaker for the Mathis brothers as Ronnie’s patience runs out. Raq makes a risky move for Kanan’s obedience.

5.o: Tension between Ronnie and Unique comes to a head while Kanan clashes with both Raq and Famous. Juke bonds with her bandmate, and Lou works to revitalize Cafe Vous. Howard’s attempt to manipulate the Task Force backfires.

6.o: Dangerous secrets are revealed as Famous unburdens himself to Kanan, and Raq finally tries to make amends with Lou. Marvin struggles with his role as stage dad, and Howard attempts to get closer to the Task Force.

7.o: Lou’s drinking creates a problem for the whole family when Shantel goes looking for justice. Kanan assimilates into Ronnie’s crew, and Raq formulates a new plan for Unique’s former heroin operation.

8.o: As a despondent Lou becomes a liability for the family, Raq and Marvin work to get the new heroin operation up and running amidst new competition from Kanan and Ronnie.

9.o: Ronnie and Kanan’s feud with Raq intensifies as Marvin desperately searches for Lou. Famous and Jukebox both find themselves at potential turning points in their music careers.

10.o: Desperation sets in as Howard tries to evade the Task Force and Ronnie goes on the attack, leaving Raq and Kanan to make some fateful choices. Ronnie changes his identity.

Meanwhile, Lou considers a new music opportunity, Marvin goes too far on a side-job for Stefano and Juke tries to adjust to life in the Army.

1.o: Daniele wakes up somewhere unexpected. He doesn't remember what happened and his family won't talk to him. And he's stuck there for seven days.

2.o: Daniele does not like his new roommates. He begins to remember what put him there and becomes obsessed with a woman in a different wing.

3.o: Daniele learns more about his roommates - the good and the bad - but he is still brooding about Nina. An unexpected visit raises his spirits.

4.o: A fire erupts in the ward, forcing everyone outside. Daniele and Nina have a conversation, and Daniele starts to warm up to his odd but sweet roommates.

5.o: The roommates get a treat from outside the hospital. Daniele and Nina make some slightly naughty plans, and for a brief moment, everything's normal.

6.o: Daniele gets rebuked for the previous night's escapade with Nina, but he doesn't care. He's learning to love life in the ward. Then, a tragic accident.

7.o: One by one, Daniele's roommates leave. He prepares to go back out into the world and realizes this might have been the sanest week of his life.

1.t: A Short Fuse and a Long Memory
1.o: On his journey to LA, Tommy stops in Chicago, only to discover shocking news about his family. Tommy must decide whether he is going to force his skeletons back in the closet, or put down roots in the Windy City.

2.o: When JP receives an unexpected warning, Tommy comes to his aide. Determined to lend a helping hand, Tommy approaches a local dealer proposing a business arrangement, but their introduction takes a turn for the worse.

3.o: Tommy finds himself face-to-face with a ghost from his past. The reunion unearths a discovery when Tommy stumbles across hidden product. Tommy brokers a sit-down between rivals and learns the true nature of the feud.

4.o: Tommy's former foe turned friend is at the mercy of a notorious criminal organization who resurface to reclaim what's theirs. The group is led by an enemy from Tommy's life back in New York who is still out for blood.

5.o: Tommy is offered a profitable solution, from an unlikely source, that may be the answer to his troubles. Intrigued, Tommy is informed he must first address a problem threatening the new venture before it begins.

6.o: Tommy and his new business partner recruit soldiers to take over the drug game in Chicago. Tommy finds a lucrative location for distribution that doesn't fit with his partner's vision for a more upscale clientele.

7.o: Tommy's new product is spreading like wildfire across Chicago. The current success isn't good enough for Tommy. He wants to own the entire city and is determined to figure out how to do so, no matter the cost.

8.o: Tommy and his crew can barely keep up with the demand and they need more help to increase their supply. More shocking details about Tommy's family surface, and he realizes the news could potentially affect his business.

9.o: Vic faces a devastating loss. Walter is ready to go to war and sends for heavy hitters. Tommy soon realizes he needs more power but is turned down by one of his closest allies and is forced to turn to an unlikely resource.

10.o: Decisions are made by those closest to Tommy which could leave him powerless. When the gangs face off, truths come to light, shifting the power of the drug game. This battle may be over, but the war is far from won.

1.o: Tommy and Diamond hustle to keep CBI's game ahead of Jenard's new faction in the streets, while Tommy makes solo moves to avenge Liliana's death. All the while, Tommy hasn't forgotten his ultimate goal to become a kingpin.

4.o: Tommy and Diamond keep dangerous secrets from each other, Jenard clashes with his crew, and Vic teams up with Claudia one last time. D-Mac ends up entangled deeper in the drug game than he ever intended.

5.o: Heightened police presence threatens Tommy and Diamond's bottom line and they form a coalition with a rival gang. Jenard hits rock bottom, and the Flynn family loyalties are tested with devastating results.

6.o: Tommy and Diamond expand their coalition by bringing Vic and Jenard into CBI. Mirković warns Tommy against encroaching on Serb territory, and makes good on his threat with catastrophic results.

7.o: Tommy and Diamond continue gaining territory behind Miguel’s back, but Diamond is pulled in other directions. Jenard gets more than he bargained for. Tommy puts Vic’s loyalty to the test.

8.o: Tommy makes bold moves to connect CBI directly with the cartel as he hustles to stay ahead of the many adversaries out for his blood. Diamond is forced to make a decision that has dire consequences.

9.o: Tommy and Diamond suspect a snitch and put their inner circle to the test. Mireya gives Tommy a key piece of information. The war between Miguel and Mirkovic comes to a head.

10.o: Tommy orchestrates the grand finale of his long game to take over Chicago’s drug world. When he is faced with devastating personal sacrifices, he finds that he might just lose more than he ever stood to gain.

1.o: تتولى جود رعاية والدها الذي يعاملها هي وشقيقتها بقسوة شديدة، ويمنعهن من استخدام أي تكنولوجيا متاحة خوفا عليهن، وتحاول أمل صديقة جود أن تنصحها بالخروج عن سجن والدها، والاعتراف للشخص الذي تعجب به بحبها.

2.o: يعلم والد جود بامتلاك شقيقتها حياة جهاز موبايل، ويوبخهن جميعا، ف ذات الوقت يعاني سامي من بخل زوجته وشكها الدائم فيه، ويتذكر مشعل كيف انفصل عن زوجته، وسبب طلاقهما، وهكذا تتذكر جود حبها لابن عمها مشعل.

3.o: تخبر حياة شقيقتها دنيا بأنها معجبة بأحد الأشخاص، ويحاول سامي إقناع مشعل بالزواج من جود ولكنه يراها غير مناسبة له، وتتمكن سلوى من خداع والدها بحالتها المادية السيئة حتى تحصل منه على أي أموال، ويستاء زوجها سامي من ذلك.

4.o: تخبر جود والدها بأن شقيقتها سلوى تخدعه وتدعي كذبا باحتياجها للأموال فيوبخها والدها، وبناء على إقناع شقيقة جود لها تحاول الاتصال بمشغل حيث تتمنى التقرب له، وفي الصباح تتشاجر مع زميلتها أمل لعرض صورها على الرجال حتى تساعدها في الزواج.

5.o: تقلق البنات لعدم عودة والدهم إلى ةلمنزل، وتتصل جود بمشغل للبحث عنه، فالوقت الذي يتوجه فيه والدهم إلى المطار لاستقبال زوجته في السر وابنه، والتي تطالبه بكتابة كل أملاكه باسمها دون بناته.

6.o: ما زال الاب سليمان مختفي ولم يعود إلى المنزل، ويشك مشعل في أنه متزوج من أخرى في السر، وتقلق جود على شقيقاتها في ظل عدم وجود والدها.

7.o: يخبر مشعل جود برغبته في الزواج من شقيقتها دنيا، فتصدم لعدم إحساسه بحبها له، ويعود سليمان إلى المنزل مع زوجته وابنه، وتشتعل النيران بينهم وبين بناته الأربع، وتهدده سلوى في حالة عدم توثيق أملاكه باسم بناته فقط.

8.o: تستمر المشاحنات بين سلوى وشقيقها، وتخبر جود شقيقتها دنيا بطلب يد مشعل لها بطريقة غير مباشرة، ويتشاحر سامي مع زوجته سلوى لبخلها الشديد، وتكتشف جود أن السائق محبوب يستغل المنزل لحسابه الخاص حيث يفتح محل حلاقة.

9.o: تتفق أميرة مع ابنها على خداع بنات سليمان بأنه كتب نصف ميراثه لكل واحدة منهن، وتنقل أمل وجود إلى وظيفة أخرى، ولكنهما مستائين من معاملة زميلاتهما لهمت في العمل الجديد.

10.o: تكتشف البنات الأربع أن شقيقهم زين خدعهن كلهن عندما ادعى أن والدهن كتب نصف أملاكه باسم كل واحدة منهن، وتطلب أميرة من زوجها سليمان أن يبحث لبناته عن منزل آخر، ويتركن لها المنزل، ويكتشف سامي أن زوجته سلوى تضرب ابنتهما بعنف بعد أن قامت المدرسة بتحويلها إلى المستشفى بسبب العنف.

11.o: تتفق أميرة مع ابنها زين على استمرار مضايقة بنات زوجها، ويتشاجر سامي مع زوجته سلوى لضرب ابنتهما، وتقرر جود التغيير من نفسها بعد أن قابلت صديقات امل.

12.o: تبدأ أميرة في تغيير أثاث وديكور المنزل، وتتفق مع ابنها على التخلص من بنات زوجها بزواجهن جميعا، وبالفعل تبدا جود هي الأخرى في التغيير بمساعدة صديقتها أمل، وتتقرب دنيا من مشعل.

13.o: تستولى أميرة على غرفة جود بالمنزل لصالح ابنها زين، الذي ينجح في التقرب إلى شقيقتيه دنيا وحياة، وفي ذات الوقت تحاول جود التقرب إلى مشعل مرة أخرى.

14.o: يدهس زين أحد الأشخاص بالسيارة، ويتم نقلها إلى المستشفى في حالة خطر، في ظل قلق والدته أميرة عليه بعد عودة شقيقته إلى المنزل دونه، ويخبر مشعل جود بأنها مثل شقيقته.

15.o: يلوم مشعل على زين لمعاملته السيئة لشقيقته، ويطلب منه التغير والتقرب لهن، وهكذا تتغير جود وتتعلم قيادة السيارة، ويقنع سامي زوجته سلوى بإقامة والدته في منزلهما مقابل مبلغ من المال، وتلوم دنيا على شقيقتها جود تقربها لمشعل.

16.o: تستاء جود من ابتعاد مشعل عنها، وفي ذات الوقت تتقرب أمل منه، وعلى الجهة الأخرى تستمر أميرة في إعطاء أدوية مخدرة لزوجها، حتى تتمكن من السيطرة عليه وبيع المنزل دون أن يدري أحد، وتنتقل أم سامي للإقامة في منزله، وتعلم أن سلوى حامل.

17.o: تفاجئ جود بعلاقة دنيا ومشعل، وفي ذات الوقت تستاء أمل لنفس السبب، وتصطحب دنيا والدها من أحد الشوارع وتلوم على أميرة سوء حالته، ويتقدم أحد الأشخاص لطلب الزواج من حياة إلا أن شقيقتها سلوى تكشف له حقيقة مرض حياة بالصرع مما ينهي مشروع الخطبة.

18.o: تخطف إحدى السيدات فجر ابنة سامي، ويظل الجميع يبحث عنها، وينقل إلى المستشفى سليمان بعد أن نقلت زوجته أميرة كل ممتلكاته إليها، ويعتدي عليها بناته بالضرب، وتطلب دنيا من مشعل التقدم للزواج منها.

19.o: يكشف سليمان لابنته جود بأن صديقة سلوى وتدعى جميلة هي التي خطفت ابنتها، وينجح سامي في إعادة ابنته، وتفاجأ جود بأن أميرة باعت المنزل واستولت على جميع الأموال.

20.o: يتركن البنات الأربع ووالدهن المنزل بعد بيعه، ويقمن لدى خالتهن ام مشعل، ويتقرب حمزة من حياة، ويخبر مشعل جود بحبه لها، ويتحول سامي في علاقاته بزوجته ويتقرب من جميلة.

21.o: تتشاجر سلوى مع زوجها وحماتها، بعد أن تكتشف علاقة سامي بجميلة، ويتقدم حمزة للزواج من حياة، وتتطور علاقة أمل بزميلاتها في العمل.

22.o: يلوم مشعل على أمه قلة المصروفات في ظل إقامة بنات خالته في منزلهما،  يعتدي سامي بالضرب على زوحته، وتطلب الطلاق، ويحاول مشعل الإصلاح بينهما.

23.o: يكشف حمزة عن جريمة قتل أحد الشباب، وتستاء سلوى من عدم إخبار شقيقتها بخطبة حياة لها، حيث تقام حفلة في منزل مشعل احتفالا بخطوبة مشعل وحمزة، ومازال مشعل يشعل النيران بقلب جود ودنيا دون أن يختار أي منهما للزواج.

24.o: تحاول جميلة إعادة علاقتها بسامي، وتطلب الزواج منه وتخبر والدته بذلك، وهكذا تحاول أم مشعل إقناع ابنها بالزواج من دنيا بالرغم من حب جود له، وتستاء جود من معاملة سلوى لزوجها وتحاول نصحها.

25.o: تطارد إحدى السيارات حمزة ودنيا، وتحاول جود رعاية والدها بعد أن فقد عقله، وتستاء رهف من معاملة امل لابنها، وعلى غير حين تبث دنيا الشك في قلب مشعل تجاه سلوك جود.

26.o: تلوم رهف على أمل معاملتها السيئة لابنها، ويفقد والد جود عقله وتطلب دنيا من شقيقتيها إدخاله مستشفى الأمراض العقلية، وتقتنع أم سامي بضرورة زواج ابنها من جميلة حتى تعطي سلوى درسا لا تنساه، ويقيم زين لدى حمزة في منزله بعد أن ترك والدته.

27.o: تلوم حياة على شقيقتها جود عدم الاعتراف بحبها لمشعل حتى تقرب لشقيقتها دنيا، وفي الوقت الذي تبدأ فيه جميلة بإحكام خطتها للتقرب من سامي يعود الأخير إلى زوجته والتقرب لها، وليلة زفاف حياة وحمزة يقتله أحد الأشخاص ويقع حادث للسيارة التي تنقله هو وزين ويتم نقل الأخير إلى المستشفى، وتصاب حياة بصدمة شديدة.

28.o: تستاء دنيا من ابتعاد مشعل عنها بعد أن نقل عمله خارج المدينة، وتضطر سلوى قبول إقامة والدها في منزلها بعد أن تطورت حالته النفسية للأسوء، وتسرق فجر أموال أمها وتعطيها لابن أمل وتدعي أن لص قام بسرقتها، ويترك والد سلوى المنزل دون أن يدري أحد.

29.o: تتهم سلوى حماتها بسرقة الأموال والذهب، ويتم القبض على ابن أمل عند بيعه الذهب، وتطلب أمه من سلوى أن تتنازل عن المحضر بعد أن علمت أن ابنتها هي التي اعطته الأموال والذهب، وما زالت جود وحياة تبحثان عن والدهما، ويعود مشعل إلى البيت ويخبر أمه بزواجه.

30.o: يكشف مشعل لأمه بأنه تزوج من أميرة بعد أن اتفق معها على أن تستغل والد جود، وساعدها في الاستيلاء على كل أمواله كما فعل والد جود مع أبو مشعل سابقا، ويرفض زين العودة إلى أمه بعد أن أصيب بالشلل، ويتمكن مشعل من نقل ملكية كل الميراث إليه.

1.o: Charismatic college student Haru starts a company with his former classmate Gaku. In need of funds, they enter an elite computer hacking competition.

2.o: Haru and Gaku establish their company with Kedoin's investment. While interviewing prospective employees, they meet a particularly honest candidate.

3.o: As part of their strategy to secure a contract, Haru and Gaku start working at a Kabukicho host club but quickly make an enemy of its top earner.

4.o: Haru decides on Trillion Game's next money-making venture: a social network game. But first, he must find a company willing to develop one.

5.o: When Haru takes the game development funds in a bid to buy a talent agency, Gaku and the developers resolve to create a great game on their own.

6.o: Hebijima clashes with Sakura after arriving at Trillion Game. Haru and Kedoin turn to God Promotion shareholders in hopes of forcing Jin to step down.

7.o: After Trillion Game starts an internet TV channel, DragonBank counters by buying a major streaming service. Haru and Gaku meet with a news director.

8.o: When Kirika makes a bold move with D-REX, Haru pursues an exclusive streaming deal with a successful anime studio and its demanding director.

9.o: After giving an answer to Kokuryu's offer, Haru sets his sights on the cashless payment industry. Kokuryu transfers Kirika to a supermarket chain.

10.o: When Trillion Game suffers a data breach, Rinrin takes the fall. Kokuryu offers to buy out the company, but Haru counters with a proposal of his own.

1.o: عندما يموت دوق "هالستيد"، يرث ابنه الثاني كل شيء، بما في ذلك اللقب والمنزل والأراضي... علاوة على مشاكل لا حصر لها.

2.o: تنطلق مطاردة يشنها وجيهان وحارس العزبة ضد فريسة من نوع آخر. وتستعين "سوزي" ببعض المساعدة لمحو آثار الفوضى، فيما تنعم عزبة "هالستيد" بزائر له قدسيته.

3.o: يتشتت انتباه "جيمي" أثناء تأدية عمله، وحين تتسبب مشاكل سلسلة التوريد في تأخير التسليمات، يضطلع شقيقا عائلة "هورنيمان" بمهمة محفوفة بالمخاطر سعيًا لإرضاء عميل مستاء.

4.o: تحرص "سوزي" على توسيع نطاق أعمالها، لكن "إيدي" يرفض رفضًا قاطعًا أن تقوم بذلك في عقاره، مما يدفع آل "هورنيمان" على البحث عن مكان بديل.

5.o: تُسبب مشاكل التوزيع في "أوروبا" ووقوع سرقة في المزرعة أزمة لـ"إيدي" و"سوزي"، إلى أن يُقدّم أحد معارفهما الجدد المساعدة لهما.

6.o: تتفاقم شكوك "إيدي" تجاه "سوزي"، لكن في ظل وجود ١٥ مليون جنيه إسترليني من الأموال المشبوهة بحاجة إلى غسلها... يجعلها تؤجل فكرة الرحيل عن العزبة.

7.o: تعتزم "سوزي" الانتقام وتعصي أوامر والدها، ويعرض "إيدي" عليها المساعدة، لكنه لم يعد واثقًا من الجهة التي يجب أن يدين لها بالولاء.

8.t: The Gospel According to Bobby Glass
8.o: يعود وجه مألوف لتصفية حسابات مع "فريدي"، ويقرر "بوبي" أنه قد حان الوقت كي يتقاعد ويطلب من "إيدي" و"سوزي" اتخاذ الإجراءات اللازمة.

1.o: ينضم زعيم عصابة إيطالي وشيخ من سلالة ملكية ولورد متعطش للمال إلى حفلة صيد ينظمها "إيدي". وفي ظل حاجته لانتزاع لقب نبيل، يحرص على نجاح ذلك اللقاء.

2.t: There's a Rat in the Kitchen
2.o: يُبرم "إيدي" صفقة مع المافيا في "ميلانو"، بينما يستعدّ "جاكي" لليلة محفوفة بالمخاطر في البلدة... لكن هل يتمكن أي منهما من الوفاء بوعده؟

3.o: مع استمرار ارتفاع تكلفة إعادة عزبة "هالستيد" إلى سابق عهدها، تتزايد أيضًا مطالب رفع أجور العاملين في المزرعة... حتى تصل إلى حدّ غير معقول.

4.o: مع انقسام مجلس اللوردات إلى جبهتين، يلجأ "إيدي" إلى الكنيسة طلبًا للمساعدة، غير أنّ كسب تأييد الأساقفة يتطلب منه تحريك المياه الراكدة.

5.t: A Suburban A-Road on the Outskirts of Basingstoke
5.o: يواجه "إيدي" عواقب عنيفة بسبب خيانته فضلًا عن تبعات القرض الذي يثقل كاهله، بينما تتجه "سوزي" و"جو" إلى "البيرو" لتوسيع التجارة من دون علم "بوبي".

6.o: يخلط "ماركو" و"إيدي" العمل بالمتعة أثناء التحضيرات ليوم زفاف "إيدي". لكن في ظل تسبب أحد الضيوف في اختلاق المشاكل، هل ينتهي الحدث بزفاف... أم جنازة؟

7.o: عندما تجتاح الآفات البشرية عزبة "هالستيد"، يقع على عاتق "جيف" مهمة القضاء عليها وإنقاذ أصحاب العمل، بينما تتهم "سوزي" والدها "بوبي" بالتلاعب بالطائرة.

8.o: يخطط "إيدي" المستشيط غضبًا للانتقام... إلى أن تتدخل "سوزي". ومع اتضاح الحقيقة وراء عملية الاقتحام، يهتز كيان آل "هورنيمان" حتّى النخاع.

1.o: تترابط جميع المخلوقات، الكبيرة منها أو الصغيرة، بشبكة حياة هائلة في الطبيعة، بدءًا من وحيد القرن في "نيبال" ووصولًا إلى الرنة في "القطب الشمالي" ومرورًا بـ"الأغوطي" في "الأمازون".

2.o: التوقيت عامل أساسي، فمن غروب الشمس إلى تعاقب المواسم ومراحل اكتمال القمر، تغدو الطبيعة في أزهى حالاتها حين تتوافق مع أطوار الحياة.

3.o: من المستحيل غضّ الطرف عن التغير المناخي بعد الآن، فبينما يختل توازن عالم الطبيعة، يصبح اتخاذ إجراءات حقيقية إزاء الأمر حاجة ضرورية أكثر من أي وقت مضى.

4.o: بينما تُخلّف حرائق الغابات وعمليات الصيد غير الشرعية الدمار وراءها، تبث عودة حيوان مفترس الحياة من جديد في المستنقعات التي أصبحت تحت سيطرة القوارض.

1.o: في الحلقة التجريبية من "فراشة"، "دايفد يانغ"، الكوري الأمريكي الذي زيّف موته قبل 9 سنوات، يواجه ماضيه عندما تقوم وكالة الاستخبارات الخاصة "كاديس" بإرسال ابنته "ريبيكا"، التي باتت تعمل لصالح الوكالة، لقتله.

2.o: يهرب كل من "دايفد" و"ريبيكا" من "كاديس" بعد مواجهة محمومة في نقطة تفتيش للشرطة. لكن لمّ شملهما غير المتوقع يتعقّد بسبب شعور "ريبيكا" بالاستياء من والدها الذي تخلى عنها.

3.o: تهرب "ريبيكا" و"دايفد" وعائلته إلى منزل آمن في مدينة "بوسان" الشاطئية. يتصاعد التوتر ضمن العائلة مع إيجاد "ريبيكا" صعوبة في تقبّل عائلة والدها الجديدة. ويجري الكشف عن معلومة تثير الصدمة حول ماضي "دايفد" مع "جونو" خلال مواجهة عنيفة في ميناء المدينة.

4.o: بعد اختطاف "أوليفر"، تستخدم "ريبيكا" و"دايفد" المعلومات التي جمعاها منه لوضع خطة للنيل من "جونو"، وهذا ما يعيدهما إلى "سول"، حيث تنتظرهما "كاديس" و"غان".

5.o: تستجوب "جونو" "أوليفر" وتكتشف أنه خانها خلال اختطافه على يد "دايفد". في غضون ذلك، يشن "دايفد" و"ريبيكا" حملة نفسية ضد "جونو"، تهدف إلى التفريق بينها وبين "أوليفر" والقضاء على "كاديس" نهائياً.

6.o: يلحق "دايفد" بـ"ريبيكا" بعد أن تعرَّضت للأسر على يد "جونو" وعملاء "كاديس"، وهذا ما يؤدي إلى مطاردة بالسيارات وإلى كمين وحشي في موقع لمصنع مهجور.
